title: CashGuard demo scenario (backend/data/scenarios/<id>.json)
description: One scripted transaction of the demo (arch 16.2) with the decision arch 16.3 expects. Read by /sim/transaction (B10, app/sim/scenarios.py) and the acceptance tests (D3). The time is relative to the sim date (2026-06-15, a Monday): day_offset days later, at time (Europe/Bucharest). Load strictly (Decimal, no duplicate keys, no NaN), as tests/unit/datafiles.py parse_json does.

id.description: Equals the file name without .json (the scenario_id of POST /sim/transaction).

acceptance.description: The arch 16.3 acceptance rows this scenario feeds.

merchant_raw.description: The bank's merchant text; C2's normalize resolves it through data/merchants.json aliases.

items.description: Receipt lines (D32), or null when the bank sent none.

day_offset.description: Days after the sim date (0 = Monday 2026-06-15; Scene D jumps to Friday = 4).

time.description: Local time of day in Europe/Bucharest, HH:MM.

requires.description: State the expected decision depends on (set up by the seed or an earlier scene).

merchant_id.description: The data/merchants.json id merchant_raw resolves to.

outcome_label.description: The matched rule's outcome label shown in the feed.
